All my previous testing was using the alpha 2 war.  I updated to main and now my previous commands run without issue.  I'm thinking whatever I ran into was resolved recently from other PRs.
Pardon the necromancy on this thread, but...
I can confirm that this has been fixed as of 6.0.0-beta-1.  Thx everyone.

reported that he cannot access resources that contain spaces after migrating to F6. This is because the migration code is missing the logic that was recently added to F6 to url encode internal ids when they are inserted into RDF.
Additionally, we should verify that spaces are not a problem for F3 migrations as well.

renderedFields.description:
Daniel Lamb reported that he cannot access resources that contain spaces after migrating to F6. This is because the migration code is missing the logic that was recently added to F6 to url encode internal ids when they are inserted into RDF.

Additionally, we should verify that spaces are not a problem for F3 migrations as well.
